home_title: Pontia — Run coding agents locally, control them anywhere
home_description: Open-source remote control for coding agents. Run pi, Codex, Claude Code, and more on your own device, then follow and steer them from any browser.
hero_description: Leave your desk, not your agents. Check in, approve, and steer every session, everywhere.
hero_copy_failed: Could not copy. Select the command to copy it.
hero_demo_caption: Interactive Dashboard demo with sample data. Select a session or switch devices to explore.
features_intro: Start work on your device. Follow it and step in from any browser.
features_subscriptions_text: Pontia doesn't sell models or tokens. Your agents run on the accounts and plans you already pay for.
features_pocket_text: Add the Dashboard to your home screen. Control from anywhere.
features_local_text: Agents run on your own devices, not a remote sandbox. Pontia connects you to them.
features_encrypted_text: Only your browser and your device can read the session. Use an official Edge or run your own. Either way, the Edge only relays ciphertext.
open_source_title: Every part of Pontia is open source.
open_source_text: The daemon, Dashboard, encryption, relay, and Cloud live in one public repository. See exactly what runs on your device.
integrations_intro: Five Agent Clients today, with deeper integration landing in each release.
integrations_caption: Pontia client integration coverage. Supported indicates implemented integration, not a guarantee for every client configuration.
faq_cloud_question: Do my agents run in Pontia Cloud?
faq_cloud_answer: No. Agent Clients, tools, credentials, and project files stay on your device. Pontia Cloud handles sign-in, device registration, and connection authorization.
faq_privacy_question: Can Pontia read my prompts or code?
faq_privacy_answer: Dashboard traffic is encrypted end to end between your browser and your device. The Edge relays ciphertext, and Pontia Cloud is not in the traffic path.
faq_agents_question: Which coding agents does Pontia support?
faq_agents_answer: Pontia integrates with pi, Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build, and OpenCode. Each agent keeps its own login, models, and sandbox, and the available controls depend on the client.
faq_platforms_answer: Pontia runs on x86_64 and ARM64 Linux and on macOS 11 or later. The Dashboard works in modern desktop and mobile browsers and can be installed to a phone home screen.
faq_cost_answer: The hosted service currently has no usage fee. You keep paying your model providers directly through your own agent accounts.
